sections.heading: Repository purpose
paragraphs: TamKungZ_ Packages is a package repository used to host packages and release artifacts published by TamKungZ_ for easier installation and download.
You may use this repository with supported package managers and build tools to download, install, update, build, test, or use packages published here.

sections.heading: Mirrors
paragraphs: Mirroring is allowed for official distribution repositories and established community package repositories, such as repositories maintained by Ubuntu or other Linux distribution communities.
Do not create or publish unofficial personal mirrors, PPAs, Launchpad repositories, or independently hosted copies of this repository without permission.
A mirror must not be presented as an official TamKungZ_ repository unless it is maintained or approved by TamKungZ_.

sections.heading: Repository use
paragraphs: Do not use this repository for abusive scraping, excessive automated requests, or other activity that disrupts normal package downloads and package-manager access.

sections.heading: Availability
paragraphs: This repository is provided as-is without uptime, compatibility, support, or warranty guarantees.
Packages, metadata, repository paths, and signing keys may change when needed for maintenance, security, or releases.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: For mirror requests, takedown requests, permissions, or repository issues, contact dev@tamkungz.me.

title: Privacy Policy
description: Privacy notes for visitors and package-manager clients using TamKungZ_ Packages.

sections.heading: Data collected
paragraphs: This site does not provide user accounts, comments, or payment forms.
Normal web server, CDN, hosting, and security logs may record request metadata such as IP address, user agent, requested URL, referrer, status code, and timestamp.

sections.heading: Analytics
paragraphs: Generated package index pages include the Ahrefs analytics script to understand aggregate site traffic.
Package managers and automated clients may also appear in server or analytics logs when they request repository metadata or artifacts.

sections.heading: Use of data
paragraphs: Operational data is used to maintain the repository, investigate abuse, debug availability problems, and understand aggregate usage.
This site does not intentionally sell personal information.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: For privacy questions or removal requests, contact dev@tamkungz.me.

title: License and Artifact Use
description: License information for this repository and the projects published through it.

sections.heading: Repository
paragraphs: TamKungZ_ Packages is a package hosting repository. It provides packages, release files, repository metadata, and related files for download and installation.
The repository itself does not determine the license of the projects or packages published through it.

sections.heading: Project licenses
paragraphs: Projects and packages published here may have their own licenses.
The license provided by each project applies to that project's source code, binaries, packages, and other artifacts as specified by that license.
Publishing a project through TamKungZ_ Packages does not replace or change the project's own license.

sections.heading: Mirroring
paragraphs: Official distribution repositories and established community package repositories may mirror packages from this repository when permitted by the applicable project license.
Do not create unofficial personal mirrors, PPAs, Launchpad repositories, or independently hosted copies of this repository without permission.
Mirroring does not transfer ownership of the packages, projects, repository metadata, names, or branding.
